## What it is

The tower at 180°, the left side. Three notches. Four clips on a 1 m strip, one quarter turn after the start tower.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side.
- The lug is 8 mm outboard of the pin.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't swap it with the 90° tower. The clips would no longer be one helix.
